results.name: Seven Stars
results.description: A contemporary Chinese restaurant on Centre Road in Bentleigh East, running for 22 years as a family-oriented eatery. The menu is casual and affordable, served to families, friends and business diners alike in a quiet dining area. Take-away is available, along with a catering service for private functions. Lunch runs Tuesday to Saturday, with dinner Tuesday through Sunday; closed Mondays except on public holidays.

results.name: Chicci
results.description: A woodfire pizzeria and bar on Kew's High Street, trading as Chicci Cucina Woodfire Pizzeria Bar. Pizzas come from a wood-fired oven, giving a crisp crust with a smoky edge, alongside pastas, salads, antipasti and desserts drawn from seasonal produce. The kitchen leans on Italian cooking and local producers, and the bar keeps a relaxed setting for lunch, dinner or drinks.

results.name: Piece of Cake Bakery
results.description: A European patisserie in Oakleigh East, operated by Kun and Jenny, who work from original recipes and traditional methods. Everything is baked on-site from scratch: cakes, sourdough croissants and bread, puff pastry pies, New York baked cheesecakes and patisseries.

results.name: Cafelito
results.description:
A coffee bar and catering kitchen in Clayton, trading as Cafelito under DAWANG Catering, serving Melbourne businesses and residents for over five years.

The breakfast menu runs to big brekkies with eggs, bacon, chorizo, mushrooms and sourdough, a vegetarian version with feta and avocado, and breakfast bruschetta with smashed avocado and poached eggs. A lunch menu uses locally sourced, seasonal produce. Alongside dine-in service, the kitchen handles custom catering for events, from intimate gatherings to corporate conferences.

results.name: Il Lido
results.description: Housed in what was once the 1930s art-deco Lido Cabaret hall on Cottesloe Beach, this Italian-inspired espresso bar and restaurant takes its name from the Italian for "the beach". The kitchen leans on cucina povera: pasta, pastries, aperitivo and espresso to grab and go. The wine list has drawn recognition, named Australia's Best Listing of Italian Wines and a finalist for Australia's Wine List of the Year. Bookings help, but walk-ins are welcome.

results.name: Sushi Hakuba
results.description:
An independent sushi shop opened by operators who spent 18 years running a franchise conveyor belt restaurant. The kitchen works in the kaiten-zushi tradition, selecting fish each morning and building each piece by hand. The chefs aim for the flavours and dishes current in Japan today rather than a fixed idea of tradition.

Found in The Pines Shopping Centre on Guineas Creek Road, Elanora, with takeaway available for pick up.
